steps.note: Remove any leftover (possibly INVALID) index from an earlier failed attempt, without blocking writes. One statement per step: CONCURRENTLY cannot run inside a transaction block.
steps.sql: DROP INDEX CONCURRENTLY IF EXISTS orders_customer_id_idx;

steps.note: Build the index on orders.customer_id without taking a write-blocking lock, so the three app replicas keep inserting and reading orders during the build.
steps.sql: CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY orders_customer_id_idx ON orders (customer_id);

steps.note: Verify the index is valid and ready; fail the plan if the concurrent build left it INVALID.
steps.sql: DO $$ BEGIN IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_index WHERE indexrelid = 'orders_customer_id_idx'::regclass AND indisvalid AND indisready) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'orders_customer_id_idx is not valid'; END IF; END $$;

steps.note: Refresh planner statistics so GET /customer/ID uses the new index.
